summary: Completed the second finding and corrected its declaration. Receipt 04fccedbacf54df3b7064fd16fa57b26 (exit 0, ten events) witnesses a violated comparison: with RestoreCommittedLogs on, no snapshot and 8402 committed entries (commit index 8402 restored), NewRaft reported newraft_returned false after a bounded 15 s wait — witness event index 9 — so startup never completes when the committed backlog needs more batches than the 128-slot FSM queue that restoreFromCommittedLogs pushes into before the FSM goroutine is started (api.go:558-561, 632-639, 724-754; raft.go:1296-1320). The below-capacity control emitted newraft_returned true after 0 ms for 8002 entries but its comparison came back unknown because both sizes shared one result event name, so each comparison looked for the other case's admission; the interpretation for 8c72cf483b114ffd808643c17dfa6945-question-1 is recorded as violated with defect_claim asserted citing that receipt, a Behavior knowledge entry is promoted for the blocking with its execution indices, the configuration-loss Fact now carries its witnessing executions, and a successor experiment with per-case result events (restart_backlog_below / restart_backlog_above, previous_id plus revision_reason) is submitted so the control can complete under fresh execution.
